questions.question: Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct? 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16
questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

Option 1) : − and ×

Given equation : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 72 - 18 ÷ 9 + 19 × 39 = 16

⇒ 72 - 18 ÷ 9 + 19 × 39 = 16

⇒ 72 - 2 + 19 × 39 = 16

⇒ 72 - 2 + 741 = 16

⇒ 813 - 2 = 16

⇒ 811 ≠ 16

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : + and ×

Given equation : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 72 + 18 ÷ 9 × 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 72 + 18 ÷ 9 × 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 72 + 2 × 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 72 + 38 - 39 = 16

⇒ 110 - 39 = 16

⇒ 71 ≠ 16

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : − and +

Given equation : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 - 19 + 39 = 16

⇒ 72 × 18 ÷ 9 - 19 + 39 = 16

⇒ 72 × 2 - 19 + 39 = 16

⇒ 144 - 19 + 39 = 16

⇒ 183 - 19 = 16

⇒ 164 ≠ 16

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : ÷ and ×

Given equation : 72 × 18 ÷ 9 + 19 − 39 = 16

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 72 ÷ 18 × 9 + 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 72 ÷ 18 × 9 + 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 4 × 9 + 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 36 + 19 - 39 = 16

⇒ 55 - 39 = 16

⇒ 16 = 16

LHS = RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "÷ and ×".

questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

28 + 14 × 7 ÷ 5 – 18 = 20
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

Option 1) : ÷ and +

Given equation is : 28 + 14 × 7 ÷ 5 – 18 = 20

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 28 ÷ 14 × 7 + 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ 28 ÷ 14 × 7 + 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ 2 × 7 + 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ 14 + 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ 19 - 18 = 20

⇒ 1 ≠ 20

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : ÷ and –

Given equation is : 28 + 14 × 7 ÷ 5 – 18 = 20

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 28 + 14 × 7 - 5 ÷ 18 = 20

⇒ 28 + 14 × 7 - 5 ÷ 18 = 20

⇒ 28 + 14 × 7 - 0.277 = 20

⇒ 28 + 98 - 0.277 = 20

⇒ 126 - 0.277 = 20

⇒ 125.722 ≠ 20

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : ÷ and ×

Given equation is : 28 + 14 × 7 ÷ 5 – 18 = 20

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 28 + 14 ÷ 7 × 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ 28 + 14 ÷ 7 × 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ 28 + 2 × 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ 28 + 10 - 18 = 20

⇒ 38 - 18 = 20

⇒ 20 = 20

LHS = RHS

Option 4) : + and ×

Given equation is : 28 + 14 × 7 ÷ 5 – 18 = 20

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 28 × 14 + 7 ÷ 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ 28 × 14 + 7 ÷ 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ 28 × 14 + 1.4 - 18 = 20

⇒ 392 + 1.4 - 18 = 20

⇒ 393.4 - 18 = 20

⇒ 375.4 ≠ 20

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "÷ and ×".

  • The founder of the Satavahana dynasty was Simuka.
    • The Satavahanas established their independent rule after the decline of the Mauryas.

    • They were also known as the Andhras.
  • Pratihara dynasty was founded by King Harichandra at Mandore, a city near Jodhpur in 640 AD.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 73rd.

Key Points

  • The 73rd Amendment of the Constitution of India envisages the Gram Sabha as the foundation of the Panchayat Raj System to perform functions and powers entrusted to it by the State Legislatures.
  • The Constitution (73rd Amendment) Act, 1992 has added a new part IX consisting of 16 Articles and the Eleventh Schedule to the Constitution.
  • The 73rd Amendment envisages the Gram Sabha as the foundation of the Panchayat Raj System to perform functions and powers entrusted to it by the State Legislatures.

Additional Information

  • The amendment provides for a three-tier Panchayat Raj System at the village, intermediate, and district levels. 
  • Articles 243A provides that the Gram Sabha may exercise such power and perform such functions at the village level as the Legislature of a State may by law provide.
  • The eleventh schedule of the constitution created by the 73rd Amendment contains 29 subjects on which the Panchayats shall have administrative control, Articles 243H empowers State Legislature to make provisions for imposing taxes, etc. by the panchayat.

  • Thus, we can conclude that the 73rd Amendment of the Constitution of India, is related to Panchayats.

Formula used:

The volume of a cylinder = π × (Radius)2 × (Height)

The volume of a sphere = (4/3) × π × (Radius)3

Calculation:

The radius of the cylindrical vessel = 32/2 = 16 cm

Let, the height of water increase = x cm

So, π × (16)2 × x = (4/3) × π × (12)3

⇒ 256x = 2304

⇒ x = 2304/256

⇒ x = 9

∴ The level of water in the vessel (in cm) will increase 9 cm

= (a + b)2/2

= (a2 + b2 + 2ab)/2

= (a2 + b2)/2 + ab

questions.questionHtml: Chords AB and CD of a circle, when produced, meet at the point P. If AB = 6.3 cm, BP = 4.5 cm, and CD = 3.6 cm, then the length (in cm) of PD is

Given:

AB = 6.3 cm, BP = 4.5 cm, and CD = 3.6 cm

Calculation:

Let, PD = x cm

We know, PB × PA = PD × PC

⇒ PB × (PB + BA) = PD × (PD + DC)

⇒ 4.5 × (4.5 + 6.3) = x × (x + 3.6)

⇒ 4.5 × 10.8 = x2 + 3.6x

⇒ 48.6 = x2 + 3.6x

⇒ 10x2 + 36x - 486 = 0

⇒ 5x2 + 18x - 243 = 0

⇒ x = \({-18 \pm \sqrt{18^2-4\times 5 \times (-243)} \over 2 \times 5}\)

⇒ x = \(\frac{-18\pm72}{10}\)

⇒ x = (-18 + 72)/10 = 54/10 = 5.4

⇒ x = (-18 - 72)/10 = - 90/10 = - 9  [Not possible]

∴ The length (in cm) of PD is 5.4 cm

questions.questionHtml: If 4 men and 6 boys can do a work in 8 days and 6 men and 4 boys can do the same work in 7 days, then how many days will 5 men and 4 boys take to do the same work?
questions.solution:
Let, M = Men; B = Boys ⇒ (4M + 6B) × 8 = (6M + 4B) × 7

⇒ 32M + 48B = 42M + 28B ⇒ M/B = 2/1

the efficiency of one man = 2, the efficiency of one boy = 1

Total work = [(4 × 2) + (6 × 1)] × 8 = 14 × 8 = 112

Efficiency of 5 men and 4 boys = (5 × 2) + (4 × 1) = 10 + 4 = 14

Required time to finish the work = 112/14 = 8 days

∴ The 5 men and 4 boys will take 8 days to do the same work
